title: BancFirst Corporation Reports First Quarter Earnings
summary: BancFirst Corporation filed a Form 8-K on April 16, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 earnings for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a regulatory wrapper that references a press release (Exhibit 99.1) for actual earnings figures; no financial data is included in the 8-K body itself.
key_points: BancFirst Corporation filed Form 8-K with the SEC on April 16, 2026.
The filing announces Q1 2026 earnings for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Earnings details are contained in Exhibit 99.1 (press release), which is not reproduced in the 8-K body.
The filing is signed by Hannah Andrus, Executive Vice President and CFO.
BancFirst trades as BANF on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.
